title: Split Manifest
description: DESIGN-stage artifact. Output of dataset-split-planner. Declares the data split for an experiment: the split unit, ratios, stratification, and per-split counts. Validated by validate_split.py which raises ValueError if split_unit is in the profile's forbidden_split_units.

split_unit.description: The unit at which splits are made, e.g. patient, case, document. Must not appear in profile.split_policy.forbidden_split_units.

splits.description: The declared splits (train, val, test, etc.)

name.description: Split name, e.g. train, val, test

fraction.description: Proportion of total data assigned to this split

n_units.description: Actual count of split_units in this split (null until data is finalized)

stratification_keys.description: Keys used to stratify this split (must be declared in profile.split_policy.stratification_keys)

frozen.description: True once test set is locked before training

leakage_declaration.description: Written declaration confirming leakage checks performed (e.g. patient_id_disjoint, volume_id_disjoint)

from_domain_profile.description: profile_id this manifest was validated against
